description: Oathe session lifecycle: the board at SessionStart, lease heartbeat at Stop, frame note before compaction. Same three events exist verbatim in Claude Code and Codex. Commands go through the shim `oathe init` materializes at $HOME/.oathe/bin/oathe — the plugin is cached by copy, so the tree carries no machine paths, and shell-form commands expand $HOME where a GUI session's bare PATH would find no bin at all.
